## Counterexample

Let $f(x) = 1$ for rational $x$ and $f(x) = 0$ for irrational $x$. On $[0, 1]$, $f$ takes no value strictly between 0 and 1. Thus the [[intermediate value theorem|PTM26N]] needs continuity.
